body: Doesn't https://github.com/symfony/symfony/pull/20716 already solve this? The fix is available since sf 2.8.15, 3.1.8 & 3.2.1.
@ogizanagi since my sf version is 3.2.8 - looks like no :/
I've managed to recreate this issue on 3.2.9. I will create PR later today

issue.title: #22839 - changed debug toolbar dump section to relative and use full window width
